-- OAuth client registry and operation progress (ADR-0082 rows B12 and D1).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".oauth_clients (
    id           UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id    TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    secret_hash  BYTEA,
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    record       JSON NOT NULL
)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oauth_clients_client_id
    ON "honua".oauth_clients (client_id)

-- payload is text so that a whole-snapshot comparison is an equality on the stored bytes.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".operation_progress (
    operation_id   TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
    operation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    status         TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_operation_progress_type
    ON "honua".operation_progress (operation_type)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_operation_progress_expires
    ON "honua".operation_progress (expires_at)
COMMENT ON TABLE "honua".oauth_clients IS 'Registered OAuth clients; the secret is stored as a SHA-256 digest and last_used_at overrides its copy in record.'
COMMENT ON TABLE "honua".operation_progress IS 'Latest progress snapshot per operation, as every job family reports it.'
